description: APSignatures is the Schema for the APSignatures API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

revision.description: Revision is the desired signature revision (e.g. "2026.01.01-3" or "latest").
Revision is the desired signature revision (e.g. "2026.01.01-3" or "latest").

repository.description:
Repository defines optional configuration for a custom signature repository.
If set, APSignatures will download from the provided repository instead of pkgs.nginx.com.

authentication.description: Authentication configures optional credentials for the repository.

secretName.description:
SecretName is the name of a Kubernetes secret containing the credentials.
For bearer: the secret must have a "token" key.
For basic: the secret must have "username" and "password" keys.

type.description: Type indicates the authentication type (bearer or basic). Required when authentication is configured.

baseUrl.description: BaseUrl is the base URL where signature .deb packages are hosted.

tls.description: TLS configures optional TLS settings for the repository.

caBundle.description: CABundle references a secret containing a PEM-encoded CA bundle (key: ca.crt).

secretName.description: SecretName is the name of the Kubernetes secret.

clientCertificate.description:
ClientCertificate references a secret that contains a client TLS certificate and key.
Expected keys: tls.crt and tls.key (security-updates-repo.crt/key are also accepted for compatibility).

secretName.description: SecretName is the name of the Kubernetes secret.

verifyCertificate.description:
VerifyCertificate controls whether the server's TLS certificate is verified.
Defaults to true. Set to false to skip verification (use with caution, for dev/test only).

installationState.description: InstallationState is the current installation state (installing, success, failure)

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration records the .metadata.generation that was last fully processed.
Used to distinguish user-initiated reconciles (spec change) from periodic requeues.
